Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome  


--- PDF page 994 ---
Page 994 
 
AND 
 
2 - Used for treatment of endogenous hypercortisolemia  
 
AND 
 
3 - One of the following:  
• 
Patient is not a candidate for surgery (e.g., adrenalectomy, transsphenoidal surgery)  
• 
Surgery has not been curative for the patient  
 
Product Name:Isturisa  
Diagnosis 
Cushing’s Syndrome  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Reauthorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Patient demonstrates positive clinical response to therapy (e.g., a clinically meaningful 
reduction in 24-hour urinary free cortisol levels, improvement in signs or symptoms of the 
disease)
